description:
Figure 5 illustrates the performance of different DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) configurations, specifically examining the effect of corpus, document, and asymmetric expansion on the dev set of MS-Marco. The x-axis represents the recall value, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1.0, in increments of 0.1. The y-axis represents the MRR (Mean Reciprocal Rank), with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1.0, in increments of 0.1.  

The plot contains four lines, each representing a different DPR configuration. The “corpus” line is green and solid, starting at approximately 0.28 MRR at 0.1 recall and increasing to 0.48 MRR at 1.0 recall. The “document” line is orange and dashed, beginning at approximately 0.31 MRR at 0.1 recall and rising to 0.51 MRR at 1.0 recall. The “asymmetric” line is purple and dotted, starting at approximately 0.33 MRR at 0.1 recall and increasing to 0.53 MRR at 1.0 recall. Finally, the “retrieve” line is teal and uses a circle marker with a solid line, beginning at approximately 0.25 MRR at 0.1 recall and increasing to 0.45 MRR at 1.0 recall.
